Metadata association atlas. The dataset-918082155360 experiment uses the rna layer. (A)
condition observations are shown against component PC1. (B) condition observations are shown
against component PC2. (C) developmental_day observations are shown against component PC1. (D)
developmental_day observations are shown against component PC2. Black monotone fits and grey
flexible fits expose agreement or possible non-monotone structure; point size records
coincident observations. The analysis unit is independent biological observation; the design is
cross_sectional; the estimand is prespecified component-metadata association. Stored intervals
and diagnostics remain descriptive. Raw p-values are retained; q-values use Holm correction
across declared components within each metadata field and evidence variant. No acceptance
threshold is applied. The atlas is exploratory and does not nominate a biological coordinate.
